subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, “CODE” is written as “DCEO”, and “MAKE” is written as “KMEA”. How will “HEAD” be written in that language?
solution:
The pattern in the given series is:

 
• **First character moves to 2ⁿd place; **
 
• **Second character moves to 4th place;**
 
• **Third character moves to 1st place;**
 
• **Fourth character moves to 3rd place**

“**CODE” is written as “DCEO”**​&
